svg.title: Raft: the ring village
svg.desc: Schematic, planned. Five houses stand in a ring on a round island; the leader's house wears the only crown. Letter-birds carry envelopes from the leader to every house: replication. A dashed fence slides across the island, cutting off the leader and one neighbour. On the majority side one house blinks its lantern and asks its neighbours for votes; two reply, and the crown hops to the new leader. The fence lifts, birds reach the old leader again and it settles back to follower. No results yet.
